mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a deepening labor market crisis that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5%, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a negative market reaction and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (industrial production declining for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits and economic contraction.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines for two months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 5 trading days indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and corporate hiring, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 2.5%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a severe demand shock that triggers a negative market reaction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (federal funds rate above 0.2% and rising), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs dampen corporate investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.2% and rising, or the Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
